title: Mounts
lead: Every secrets engine and auth method plugs into the path bus through its own socket. Mount an engine, tune its TTLs, or pull the plug, taking the data under the path with it.

unit.experimentalHint: Experimental engine: off by default, needs the --enable-engine flag

detail.tableOnly: A mount-table entry without an engine: nothing is stored under this path.
detail.partial: More secrets than the scan limit: the version figures are approximate.
detail.hidden: Secrets whose metadata you cannot read: {{count}}. They are left out of the version figures.

noMatch.title: Nothing found
noMatch.text: No mounts match this filter. Clear the search or pick "All".

empty.title: No mounts yet
empty.text: Nothing is plugged into the path bus. Mount a secrets engine or an auth method, and add the rest as you need it.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.text: Your token is not allowed to read the list of mounts. Ask an administrator to add the lines below to your policy. The list appears right away, no re-login needed.

error.title: Could not read mounts
error.message: The server did not answer or returned an error. Check the connection and try again.

wizard.intro: Mount a new secrets engine or auth method at any path. Existing mounts are not affected. TTLs and other settings are tuned after mounting.

transit.name: Transit
transit.desc: Encryption as a service: the app never sees the key.

approle.name: AppRole
approle.desc: Machine login with role_id and secret_id for CI/CD.

jwt.name: JWT / OIDC
jwt.desc: Login with a JWT from the corporate identity provider.

pki.name: PKI
pki.desc: Certificates from your own CA for internal use (mTLS, tests).

ssh.name: SSH
ssh.desc: Signed SSH certificates for host access.

custom.name: Other type
custom.desc: Any other type the server understands.

wizard.expTitle: The {{type}}/ engine is off by default.
wizard.expText: This is an experimental subsystem. You can register the mount, but its API answers 404 until the server is started with the flag:
wizard.errCustomType: Only lowercase latin letters, digits, "-" and "_"
wizard.pathErrChars: Lowercase latin letters, digits, "-" and "_" only; separate segments with "/"
wizard.pathErrTaken: Path {{path}} is taken: {{type}} is mounted there
wizard.descPlaceholder: What this engine is for, visible to every admin

tune.title: Tune {{path}}
tune.loadFailed: Could not read the current settings. Saving will overwrite them with the values below.
tune.ttlHint: 0 means no override: system defaults apply.
tune.noCacheDesc: force_no_cache · for data that must not be held in memory
tune.errOrder: Max TTL cannot be lower than the default TTL

unmount.title: Unmount?
unmount.message: This unmounts "{{path}}" together with its data.
unmount.warn: All data under {{path}} is lost for good, and clients using this path lose access. It can only be restored from a snapshot.
unmount.impactLoading: Counting what depends on this mount...
unmount.tableOnly: This is a mount-table entry without an engine: no data or leases live under it, only the entry is removed.
